methodSourceMeaning.national: Method published by the country’s own religious authority.
methodSourceMeaning.regional: Method of a neighbouring/regional authority that the country commonly follows.
methodSourceMeaning.default: No documented country convention; the global fallback method is used.

AE.name: United Arab Emirates
AE.notes: Umm al-Qura is the common Gulf default; AlAdhan documents the Gulf Region method as the closest match to UAE Awqaf, and Dubai (IACAD) publishes 18.2°/18.2° timings.

AF.name: Afghanistan
AF.notes: Matches the 18°/18° convention used in Afghanistan.

AS.name: American Samoa
AS.notes: ISNA angles are the default used in American Samoa.

BD.name: Bangladesh
BD.notes: Matches the 18°/18° convention used by the Islamic Foundation Bangladesh.

BH.name: Bahrain
BH.notes: Umm al-Qura is the Gulf default used for Bahrain.

DZ.name: Algeria
DZ.notes: Maliki madhab uses the single-shadow Asr rule (madhab "shafi" in the API).

GB.name: United Kingdom
GB.notes: ISNA 15°/15° is the widely used UK default and copes better with UK summer twilights than 18° angles.

GS.name: South Georgia and the South Sandwich Islands

IN.name: India
IN.notes: University of Islamic Sciences, Karachi is the prevailing convention in India.

IR.name: Iran
IR.notes: Iran is normally served by the Tehran/Jafari methods, which the runtime cannot reproduce yet (they need Maghrib from an angle). MWL is used until then.

JO.name: Jordan
JO.notes: The Jordanian ministry method is Fajr 18°/Isha 18° with sunset + 5 minutes for Maghrib; the 18°/18° part matches `karachi`, and the Maghrib offset is documented in methods.json > unimplemented.

KW.name: Kuwait
KW.notes: Kuwaiti Ministry of Awqaf convention: Fajr 18°, Isha 17.5°.

LY.name: Libya
LY.notes: Egyptian General Authority of Survey is the default used in Libya.

NG.name: Nigeria
NG.notes: The Egyptian authority is the common Nigerian default; MWL is the usual alternative.

OM.name: Oman
OM.notes: Umm al-Qura is the Gulf default used for Oman.

PT.name: Portugal
PT.notes: The Comunidade Islamica de Lisboa method (sunset + 3 min, Isha 77 min) is not implemented by the runtime yet.

QA.name: Qatar
QA.notes: Qatar Calendar House timings: Fajr 18°, Isha 90 minutes after Maghrib.

SA.name: Saudi Arabia
SA.notes: Umm al-Qura University (Makkah) is the official Saudi calendar authority.

SD.name: Sudan
SD.notes: Egyptian General Authority of Survey is the default used in Sudan.

SS.name: South Sudan
SS.notes: Egyptian General Authority of Survey is the default used in South Sudan.

SY.name: Syria
SY.notes: Umm al-Qura is the commonly used default for Syria.

YE.name: Yemen
YE.notes: Umm al-Qura is the Gulf default used for Yemen.
